title: Critique: the model is of representation, not attention

statements.text: Perceptual awareness presents itself as covering all perception, attended or not, so the complex relation that the model simplifies may be perception or representation in general rather than attention.

sources.quote: Another difference with Graziano is that I am not sure that attention is the right choice for the complex relation that is being modelled.
our model of consciousness is a primitive model of complex relations of representation
